title: Reviews
summary: --Reviews is a free-floating form subdivision under Books, types of books, non-book materials, and headings for mass media and the performing arts; --Book reviews is free-floating under topical headings and names of places for collections of appraisals of books on those subjects. Newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews and [...] newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews cover review columns. Writing book reviews takes the topical heading Book reviewing.
validation_rules: `Books--Reviews` is used for collections of reviews of books on many subjects, only when too broad for a more specific heading. (H 2021 sec. 1.a)
`--Reviews` is free-floating under headings for types of books, e.g. `Reference books--Reviews`. (H 2021 sec. 1.a)

`--Book reviews` (not `--Reviews`) is the free-floating form subdivision under topical headings and names of places for collections of appraisals of books on those subjects, e.g. `Art--Book reviews`, `California--Book reviews`, `United States--History--Civil War, 1861-1865--Book reviews`. (H 2021 sec. 1.b)
`--Reviews` and `--Book reviews` are form subdivisions (`$v`) and may be followed by further form subdivisions, e.g. `Books--Reviews--Periodicals`. (H 2021 background, sec. 1)
Works on the technique of writing book reviews take the topical heading `Book reviewing` (May Subd Geog). (H 2021 sec. 1.a note)

Newspaper review columns: `Newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews` and `[...] newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews`, e.g. `Canadian newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews` (here `--Reviews` is coded `$x`). (H 2021 sec. 2)
`--Reviews` is free-floating under headings for non-book materials, e.g. `Compact discs--Reviews`, `Audiotapes--Reviews`. (H 2021 sec. 3)

`--Reviews` is free-floating under headings for mass media and the performing arts, and may follow a geographic subdivision, e.g. `Television programs--United States--Reviews`, `Performing arts--England--London--Reviews`, `Theater--Reviews`. (H 2021 sec. 4)

sections.heading: a. Books--Reviews
sections.text:
Use the free-floating subdivision --Reviews under the heading Books for collections of descriptive and evaluative accounts of books on many subjects. Example:

```
Title: Book review digest.
650 #0 $a Books $v Reviews $v Periodicals.
```

Assign this heading only to collections too broad to be assigned a more specific heading.

Note: For works about the technique of writing book reviews, assign the topical heading Book reviewing (May Subd Geog).

Also use the free-floating subdivision --Reviews under headings for types of books, for example, Reference books--Reviews.

sections.heading: b. [topic]--Book reviews
sections.text:
Assign the free-floating subdivision --Book reviews under topical headings and names of places for collections of appraisals of books on these topics. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Art $v Book reviews.
651 #0 $a California $v Book reviews.
650 #0 $a English literature $y l9th century $x History and criticism $v Book reviews.
650 #0 $a French imprints $v Book reviews.
650 #0 $a Medicine $v Book reviews.
651 #0 $a United States $x History $y Civil War, 1861-1865 $v Book reviews.
```

sections.heading: 2. Newspapers
sections.text:
Assign the heading Newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews and headings of the type [...] newspapers--Sections, columns, etc.--Reviews for works on the writing and editing of reviews of books, music, theater, etc., and for collections of these writings. Example:

```
650 #0 $a Canadian newspapers $x Sections, columns, etc. $x Reviews.
```

sections.heading: 3. Non-book materials
sections.text:
Assign the free-floating subdivision --Reviews under headings for non-book materials for collections of descriptive and evaluative accounts of these materials. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Compact discs $v Reviews.
650 #0 $a Audiotapes $v Reviews.
```

sections.heading: 4. Mass media and performing arts
sections.text:
Assign the free-floating subdivision --Reviews under headings for mass media and the performing arts for collections of critical writings about programs, performances, etc. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Performing arts $z England $z London $v Reviews.
650 #0 $a Television programs $z United States $v Reviews.
650 #0 $a Theater $v Reviews.
```
